description: This file declares the interface and components related to Fastboot configuration within the Cuttlefish Android project. It includes interface definitions, class declarations, and component functions for dependency injection.

classes.name: FastbootConfig
classes.description: An interface class for Fastboot configuration settings, providing virtual methods for proxy status checks and updates.

classes.name: FastbootConfigFragment
classes.description: A class derived from ConfigFragment, likely used to group related configuration options.

classes.name: FastbootConfigFlag
classes.description: A class derived from FlagFeature, probably representing a feature flag for Fastboot.

methods.name: ProxyFastboot
methods.description: Returns whether the Fastboot proxy is enabled.

methods.name: FastbootConfigComponent
methods.description: Creates a dependency injection component for FastbootConfig.

methods.name: FastbootConfigFlagComponent
methods.description: Creates a DI component with required FastbootConfig and ConfigFlag, and FastbootConfigFlag.

methods.name: FastbootConfigFragmentComponent
methods.description: Creates a DI component with required FastbootConfig and FastbootConfigFragment.

methods.name: LaunchFastbootComponent
methods.description: Creates a DI component requiring KernelLogPipeProvider, CuttlefishConfig::InstanceSpecific, and FastbootConfig.
